1. A 58-year-old woman with hypertension and paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
conduction slowing. Which benzothiazepine derivative is most appropriate?
(a) Nifedipine
(b) Verapamil
-(c) Diltiazem
(d) Nicardipine
2. A 32-year-old Caucasian woman experiences chest pain with exertion. She reports having
similar episodes in the past It is determined that she is experiencing stable angina. She is
given nitro-glycerine to relax her vascular smooth musculature. Which best describes a
step on nitro-glycerine's mechanism of action?
(a) Activation of adenylate cyclase
.(b) Activation of guanylate cyclase
(c) Inhibition of calcium channels
(d) Inhibition of cGMP phosphodiesterase
3. Why is the onset of action of lidocaine delayed in infected tissue?
(a)Increasedhepaticclearance
(b) Decreased un-ionized drug available to cross the nerve membrane
(c) Rapid degradation by tissue esterases
(d) Downregulation of voltage-gated sodium channels
